description: This Java source file defines a custom Swing component called URLLabel, which extends JLabel to display clickable hyperlinks that open in the default web browser. It manages URI creation, styling, mouse interactions, and error handling related to opening URLs.

classes.name: URLLabel
classes.description: A custom Swing JLabel component that displays clickable hyperlinks which open in the system default browser. It supports setting URLs via string or URI, styling, and mouse interactions for hover and click events.

methods.name: URLLabel
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the label with display text and a URI.

methods.name: URLLabel
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the label with display text and a URL string, converting it to URI.

methods.name: createUri
methods.description: Creates a URI object from a string, throwing RuntimeException if invalid.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Configures the label with text, URI, cursor, tooltip, and mouse listeners for hover effects and URL opening.

methods.name: addUrlAction
methods.description: Adds a mouse listener to the component that opens the link when clicked.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Overrides JLabel's setText method to include styling for hyperlinks.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets the label's text with optional underline styling.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Attempts to open the given URI in the system default browser, with error handling and user notifications.
